name: vaxetherion-profile
description: GitHub profile assets, automation, and E2E validation for @vaxetherion

scripts.test: npm run assets && node scripts/validate-assets.js && npm run lint && npm run audit && playwright test
scripts.audit:
npm audit --audit-level=critical 2>/dev/null || (echo '
🚨 npm audit menemukan vulnerabilitas kritis! Periksa output di atas.
   Jalankan: npm audit fix
   Atau: npm audit --json untuk detail lengkap.' && exit 1)
